name: Company Runner
title: The Errand Legs
examine: Mud to the knee from three cities' worth of cellars, and a satchel that is nobody's business.
lines: Five doors and I know every step between them. Ask me nothing about any of it.
Amberford by the reeds, Hartfell by the fur hall. That is not a secret, that is a delivery route.
The Tollhouse crew think they work hard. They stand next to a road all day. I AM the road.
